thread.title: Qualcomm ( QCOM ) continues to remain in the headlines for i

author: Stone Fox Capital
title: Qualcomm ( QCOM ) continues to remain in the headlines for i
text:
Qualcomm ( QCOM ) continues to remain in the headlines for issues that pulls the focus away from a strong core business. The wireless tech company remains embroiled in a public royalty battle with Apple ( AAPL ) and multiple merger discussions, but the market keeps missing the context of the core business and the ability of the company to thrive regardless.
The stock trades at recent highs, but plenty of catalysts exist for a higher price.
Core Forecast In general, the market is highly focused on the licensing disputes that include Apple not paying at previous agreements. Any negative outcome to these disputes will hurt results, but investors need to understand that Qualcomm has a substantial business that has a forecasted core earnings level of $5.25 per share in FY19.
The company recently reported earning $4.28 per share in FY17 that included two quarters of Apple and its contract manufacturers withholding royalty payments. The licensing resolutions with Apple and others is a big impact with a potential hit of $1.50 to $2.25 per share to earnings potential in FY19 and presumably similar amounts for the current year. The key point being that Qualcomm forecasts an EPS potential of up to $7.50 per share based on resolution of license disputes.
